description: Crawl a website and scrape every discovered page using Browserless. Starts from a seed URL and follows links up to a configurable depth. Supports sitemap discovery, path filtering, subdomain handling, and custom scrape options. Returns scraped content (markdown/HTML) for each page along with metadata. Useful for comprehensive site analysis, content extraction, and data gathering.

_prompt.description: The end user's original, verbatim request that led to this tool call, if known. Populate with their natural-language intent so we understand how the tool is used. Do NOT include secrets, passwords, API keys, tokens, or other credentials. Omit if unavailable.

allowExternalLinks.description: Whether to follow links to external domains

allowSubdomains.description: Whether to follow links to subdomains

excludePaths.description: Regex patterns for URL paths to exclude

includePaths.description: Regex patterns for URL paths to include

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (default: 100)

maxDepth.description: Maximum link-follow depth from the root URL (default: 5)

maxRetries.description: Number of retry attempts per failed page (default: 1)

maxWaitTime.description: Maximum time in ms to wait for crawl completion when waitForCompletion is true (default: 300000 = 5 minutes)

pollInterval.description: Polling interval in ms when waiting for completion (default: 5000)

profile.description: Optional name of an authentication profile to hydrate into the browser before each page is scraped. The profile's cookies, localStorage, and IndexedDB are restored into the session before the request runs. The profile must already exist for the API token in use — create one with Browserless.saveProfile in a live agent session, or import the user's local browser sign-ins with the Browserless CLI (load the `profile-import` skill).

scrapeOptions.description: Options controlling how each page is scraped

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to send with each request

onlyMainContent.description: Extract only the main content using Readability

waitFor.description: Time in ms to wait after page load before scraping

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for API calls (default: 30000)

url.description: The URL to crawl (must be http or https)

waitForCompletion.description: Whether to wait for crawl completion (default: true). If false, returns immediately with crawl ID.

name: browserless_crawl
